voice:
In trance, bodies don't stay solid, Sissy. Yours is beginning to soften already... right at the edges.
You may already feel it... the outline of you going blurry... the firmness dissolving out of your shoulders... your spine losing its shape.
You are turning soft and slow... like chocolate left in the sun... like a candle flame leaning... like ice becoming water.
And everything that melts... pools. That is the nature of a melt. It gathers... and it sinks.
So you sink... a slow warm puddle of you, spreading thinner and deeper. Down you run... liquid and lazy, pooling in the lowest, deepest place. Your edges give way... and what is left of you slides gently downward. Softer... and softer... and with every softening, further down. The last of your shape drips away... and the puddle of you settles deeper. You are pouring yourself out... downward, where the deep receives you. Warm liquid you... finding every low place and filling it... sinking as you fill it. Melted and mingling... you spread out and down, down, down. There is no solid you left to hold you up... so down you go, sweetly. Softness upon softness... pooling deeper with every passing second. Completely unlaced... you flow lower, following gravity like honey. Edgeless, formless, warm... a small dark pool getting deeper and deeper.
Sissies like you melt so easily for my voice... no resistance in you at all... just softness finding its level.
And now the deepest part of the melt... the last drop... falling.
Sissy Drop.
Down... one warm drop of you, falling through the deep... and landing so very deep.
Good girl. Pooled and poured and perfectly deep... deeper still.
